name: Morbent Fel
summary: Above Raven Hill Cemetery, Morbent Fel's wards keep him beyond ordinary steel. Sven Yorgen sends you with Morbent's Bane to break those wards and end the necromancer's terror in western Duskwood.

sections.title: The Perch Above the Dead
sections.body: Morbent Fel haunts an abandoned house atop a rocky ridge just east of Sven's camp. The house looks over the sprawl of Raven Hill Cemetery. From there, the necromancer sends waves of undead through the surrounding forest and defiles Duskwood's graves. Dark magic and loyal undead thralls have kept ordinary steel from reaching him.

sections.title: Sven's Vengeance
sections.body: Dark forces butchered Sven Yorgen's family and drove him into hiding, leaving him mad with grief. Sven knows the enigmatic Dark Riders of Karazhan were responsible for the massacre at his farm. Morbent Fel's vile sorcery has kept the region's nightmare alive. Striking down the necromancer offers Sven the only tangible shred of justice left in this blighted land.

sections.title: Morbent's Bane
sections.body: Morbent Fel's wards turn a direct assault into suicide, deflecting conventional attacks. Sven entrusts you with Morbent's Bane, an enchanted artifact made to unravel that magical shielding. Invoke the relic and the barrier collapses, leaving Fel open to a mortal strike.

faq.answer: Morbent Fel commands the undead infesting the Raven Hill region. He lurks in a house atop a hill overlooking Raven Hill Cemetery, using dark sorcery to shield himself while tormenting Duskwood's living.

faq.q: Why is Morbent's Bane necessary to kill him?
faq.answer: Morbent Fel's potent wards turn aside ordinary attacks and leave him almost invulnerable. Morbent's Bane is an enchanted relic made to dispel those protections and expose him to harm.

faq.q: What is Sven Yorgen's connection to Morbent Fel?
aliases: why does sven want morbent dead
faq.answer: Dark entities stalking Duskwood took Sven Yorgen's family and farm from him. Sven knows the mysterious Dark Riders were responsible for the slaughter, while Morbent Fel's necromantic grip on the countryside embodies the evil plaguing western Duskwood. Destroying Fel gives Sven a target for his vengeance.

faq.q: Where can Morbent Fel be found?
faq.answer: Morbent Fel lives on the upper floor of a decrepit, ruined house on a hill directly east of Sven Yorgen's camp, overlooking the western side of Raven Hill Cemetery.

faq.q: Did Morbent Fel kill Sven's family?
faq.answer: No. The mysterious Dark Riders seeking the Scythe of Elune slaughtered Sven's family. Morbent Fel's necromancy plagued the surrounding region and desecrated Duskwood's graves, so his destruction is essential to reclaiming peace.

faq.q: What happens after Morbent Fel is slain?
faq.answer: Returning Morbent's Bane to Sven brings the grieving hermit a small measure of solace. The elusive Dark Riders remain at large, but Fel's death breaks the necromantic grip over Raven Hill and secures your reputation across Duskwood.

angles.text: Slaying Morbent Fel removes one of the gravest threats over Duskwood's people, secures the road, and honors the suffering of western settlements like Raven Hill.
As a paladin, striking down a foul necromancer and cleansing Raven Hill of his unnatural wards answers the calling of a knight of the Holy Light.
As a priest, you can answer Raven Hill Cemetery's desecration with spiritual cleansing and dispel Fel's sorcerous wards as a holy duty.
